# Security Policy

## Supported versions

This is an educational repository. Only the latest version on the `main` branch is actively maintained.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security vulnerability.

Report it privately to the repository maintainer through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature or a private GitHub message. Include:

- A clear description of the issue.
- Steps to reproduce it.
- The affected file or dependency.
- Any suggested mitigation.

Please allow time for the issue to be assessed before publishing details publicly.
